terminals.name: api
terminals.description: BotStudio backend (Fastify) on http://localhost:3001 — REST + WebSocket chat, /api/health. Reads LLM keys from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/GEMINI_API_KEY (falls back to CLAUDE_API_KEY) and optional SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY.
terminals.command: cd api && ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:-$CLAUDE_API_KEY}" JWT_SECRET="${JWT_SECRET:-dev-local-jwt-secret-change-me-32chars}" NODE_ENV=development PORT=3001 ALLOWED_ORIGINS="*" node server.js

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Static file server for the dashboard (index.html/botstudio.html), direct chat page (chat/) and widget demo (widget/demo.html) on http://localhost:8080.
